newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares, bonds drop on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares, bonds drop on U.S. data.

text.p: Swiss shares and bonds fell sharply on news that the Chicago Purchasing Managers had surged to 60.0 in August from 51.2 in July, dealers said.
The SMI share index dropped to 3,646.3 just before the close from 3,656 on the news. The index was down around one percent from the previous close.
The September government bond future fell to 112.50 from 113.13 but bounded back to around 113, some 25 basis points below the close.
